result: All 19 tests in four suites passed. The previously uncovered nonfinite-source and finite-overflow cases are now rejected in the tested paths.
static_review: ProjectStore scans copied imports and deletes the new copy on failure; load scans each resolved unique media URL.
Preparation checks decoded buffer values and gained Float values for finiteness before returning prepared buffers.
OfflineRenderer.mix checks each Float accumulation result and throws nonFiniteAudio on overflow; it does not clamp ordinary finite samples above unity.
Preparation preflights overlapping intervals with the same deterministic offline mixer before transport or export consumes the prepared project.
Export writes a temporary file before final replacement; new typed-error tests demonstrate previous destination preservation and temporary-file cleanup.
important_limit: The preparation check establishes finiteness for the application's offline accumulation order. AVAudioEngine hardware mixer grouping/order/precision is not established. A cancellation-heavy extreme-amplitude mixture can depend on accumulation order, so this is not an unconditional proof of all native playback arithmetic.
